method: GitHub public issue search and issue GET endpoints; openai/codex scope; newest-sorted first pages only

query_log.query: repository openai/codex; phrase unrelated fork; term subagent
repository openai/codex; phrase wrong parent; terms subagent message
repository openai/codex; phrase cross-thread; terms subagent result
repository openai/codex; phrase task_complete; terms parent message

selected_reviews.title: Desktop subagent sends progress to historical unrelated task and parent confuses relayed task identity
selected_reviews.assessment: The reporter found fourteen worker messages addressed to an unrelated historical task and twelve corresponding received messages. That task woke, acknowledged and relayed the material; the parent then used the relay identity and polled the wrong task. This is a concrete transfer-response-use chain across an unintended recipient boundary, but it was publicly reported in September and does not establish a rogue swarm or backend misdelivery.
selected_reviews.verified_participants: Parent, worker and unrelated task sessions asserted from local transcript metadata; model identities not independently authenticated
selected_reviews.provider_attribution: OpenAI Codex Desktop; effective worker model not established

selected_reviews.title: Native subagent reports to unrelated fork instead of its recorded parent
selected_reviews.assessment: A worker with a recorded parent selected a sibling fork as the destination for an implementation progress report, and the unrelated fork responded. This establishes a transfer-and-response across an unintended task boundary. The sender explicitly selected the wrong destination, so the report does not show transport-layer misdelivery; it was already public in September.
selected_reviews.verified_participants: Parent, worker and fork sessions asserted from local rollout metadata; model identities not independently authenticated
selected_reviews.provider_attribution: OpenAI Codex Desktop; effective worker model not established

selected_reviews.title: A reassigned descendant reports completion to its spawn parent instead of the requester
selected_reviews.assessment: A descendant completed reassigned work twice, but terminal results followed spawn-time parent routing and never reached the requesting root. This is a deterministic completion-routing failure with successful work and orphaned results; the dormant recipient did not use them, and the episode does not show unauthorized coordination.
selected_reviews.verified_participants: Root, intermediate parent and descendant sessions asserted from local rollout metadata; model identities not independently authenticated
selected_reviews.provider_attribution: OpenAI Codex CLI; root reported as gpt-5.6-sol; descendant model not established

assessment.result: No previously unreported rogue swarm. Two already published incidents preserve wrong-recipient transfer-and-response chains across task boundaries; a third is a completion-routing bug without result use.
assessment.advancement_test: A new candidate needs a not-previously-published exchange, independent provenance for autonomous participants, evidence that the recipient used the transferred task result, and evidence that the exchange exceeded operator authorization rather than reflecting a routing defect alone.

limitations: Four repository-scoped first pages are not a census; two searches were capped at 30 results.
Issue bodies summarize privately retained local transcripts; this pass did not access those private records or independently authenticate session identities.
Wrong destination selection is not the same as transport-layer misdelivery, and open issue state does not establish ongoing activity.
No reproduction, agent invocation, cross-task message, local-log read or external write was performed.
redactions: Thread and session identifiers, business content, commands, local paths, raw messages and private logs omitted; issue bodies represented by SHA256
